edges_rejected_or_unproved: CiNii and NDL search records for NCID BA59231697 share catalog data and do not represent independent ancient copies.

A verified IHP provenance institution is not a verified original barcode174009 identity for the published facsimile.
The 2010 Google scan describes a digitization of a 1976 publication and is not itself an eighteenth- or nineteenth-century image witness.
